descriptionChirho: The proper name Barzillai (Hebrew בַּרְזִלַּי), borne by at least three individuals: (1) Barzillai the Gileadite, the wealthy elderly supporter of David during Absalom's rebellion (2 Samuel 17:27; 19:31-39; 1 Kings 2:7); (2) Barzillai the Meholathite, father-in-law of Adriel (2 Samuel 21:8); (3) a priestly family who took the name from the Gileadite (Ezra 2:61; Nehemiah 7:63). The two clusters differ only in grammatical context (with conjunction/preposition vs bare name or genitive). Uniformly rendered: English 'Barzillai', Spanish 'Barzilai', Hindi बर्जिल्लै, Arabic بَرْزِلَّايَ, Korean 바르실라이, Swahili 'Barzilai'.
